staticChecks: Python AST and JSON parse only. No script, build, test, or model run.
partialEvidence: Raw stderr phases and process/system samples survive abort. A result file is not required for partial memory evidence.
resultGate: Complete exit 0, exact 29 IDs including EOS, 28 consumed inputs, 1120 accepted routes, final position1203/pending1, serial transaction and cleanup checks, internal and external memory floors.
timingLimit: Exploratory timing only. Request excludes model load. No speed comparison.
markerLimit: The last saved phase is evidence only. residencyRequestAfter means the call returned, not physical residency.
buildRequirement: Main must use the source owner frozen inventory, stable build receipt, and matching overlay/binary hashes. This handoff is not build evidence.
